statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADDRESSING CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
statements.title: ADDRESSING CALIFORNIA WILDFIRES
sentences: There is a separation, I guess, in how we approach our response to changing climate.
It was said by members of the climate commission at Oregon State University that if we stopped all CO2 production today, our climate would not improve for between 30 and 40 years.
Wishing this away or blaming it on climate change and shrugging ones' shoulders that this isn't happening will not work.
During this period of time, we are going to see a repeat of what we are seeing in southern California unless we do something about it.
We want you to not just come in and help repair and clean up, which we will do, but, also, we want you to try to stop the damage that is being done to our forests.
